[RLOW.4.6.2.3] **Activation key.** The activation key is what the rule's
`by:` modifier names per [LCDB.3.3.4], or, with none, is composed per
[LCDB.3.3.3]. Different keys have independent cooldown state.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_3__cool_perkey
idris.note: Different keys, independent state: two keys in one pump both fire. Executed.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_3__key_separates
idris.note: Different keys, independent state: a key inside another key's window fires. Executed.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_3__other_key_unmoved
idris.note: DIFFERENT KEYS HAVE INDEPENDENT COOLDOWN STATE: a stamp under one key leaves every other key's lookup as it was, over every pair of distinct keys, instant and table.
